fonts.display: 'Nyght Serif', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif
fonts.body: 'Switzer', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text, filled buttons, dark surface backgrounds, heading strokes — a warm-tinted near-black that replaces pure #000 throughout the system

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, light section backgrounds, button borders on dark surfaces

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Secondary body text, helper text, muted borders, low-emphasis UI metadata
